en.title: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish Details Deep Character Customization Options
en.summary: A new trailer for Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish reveals a surprisingly robust character creation system, allowing players to meticulously craft their vampire-hunting avatars. Beyond aesthetics, the game emphasizes player choice through customizable Archetypes and the inclusion of Flaws.
en.body:
The upcoming **Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish** is shaping up to be more than just a straightforward action title; it's leaning into the rich role-playing roots of the **World of Darkness** with an impressive character creation system.

A recently released trailer, dubbed "Deathwish," has pulled back the curtain on how players will define their hunters, and the options go far beyond a simple name and class selection. From the moment you begin, you'll have the chance to sculpt your avatar with a variety of presets that can be further customized. This includes adjustments to body type, lower body features, hairstyles, makeup, and even arm tattoos. The game also promises a wide array of clothing options, catering to diverse styles, whether your hunter prefers a more casual look or something more formal for their nocturnal pursuits.

These aesthetic choices are just the beginning. **Deathwish** introduces Archetypes, which dictate your hunter's core skills and primary and secondary attributes. For those who prefer complete control, a custom option is available, allowing players to allocate points into stats like Charisma, Dexterity, and Intelligence. These attributes directly influence corresponding skills such as Melee, Intimidation, and Persuasion, playing a crucial role in skill checks and narrative outcomes. Echoing systems found in games like **The Outer Worlds**, players can further refine their character by equipping Advantages and Flaws. These can modify specific skills or grant unique benefits, such as a critical hit chance increase, adding another layer of strategic depth to character building.

## Crafting Your Hunter's Identity

The depth of character creation in **Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish** is a significant draw for fans of the **World of Darkness** setting. It’s not just about looking the part; it’s about building a hunter that reflects your playstyle and narrative choices. The inclusion of Archetypes and customizable attributes ensures that players can create unique characters that excel in different areas, whether they are a charismatic negotiator or a stealthy assassin. The decision to incorporate Flaws, similar to systems in other acclaimed RPGs, adds a fascinating twist, forcing players to balance powerful abilities with inherent weaknesses. This mechanic promises to create more memorable and challenging gameplay experiences, as every advantage comes with a potential drawback.

## What This Means for the Hunt

This emphasis on player agency in character creation signals a commitment to a more immersive and personalized experience. For fans of **Hunter: The Masquerade** and its lore, the ability to intricately design their hunter, from their physical appearance to their core competencies and even their personal failings, is a crucial element that brings the dark, personal stories of the **World of Darkness** to life. It suggests that the game will not only focus on visceral combat but also on the role-playing aspects that have made the franchise a beloved fixture in the supernatural horror genre for decades. The choices players make in character creation will likely have a tangible impact on how they navigate the treacherous world of vampire hunting in New York.

## What's Next

**Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish** is slated for release in Q3 2027 on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, and PC. Further details on the game's "pillars" of hunting have been promised, so keep an eye on official announcements.

content_raw: RoboCop and Terminator: Resistance developer Teyon’s next game is something decidedly different. It’s a new Hunter: The Reckoning focusing on hunting vampires in New York. As action-packed as that sounds, it’s also a game of choices, starting with how your hunter will look. A new trailer outlines what you should know about character creation, and it’s surprisingly robust. Several presets are available, and you can customize them, adjusting everything from Body Build and Lower Body to Hairstyle, Makeup, and even Arm Tattoos. A variety of clothing is available, so whether it’s something casual or more formal, it’s all here. There’s more, including a selection of Archetypes that determine which core skills you’ll excel at and your primary and secondary attribute (though a Custom option is also available). You can put points into Charisma, Dexterity, Intelligence, and more, and further improve their corresponding Skills, like Melee, Intimidation, Persuasion, etc. All of that plays into skill checks and the outcome of certain situations. Like The Outer Worlds , you can equip Advantages and Flaws to modify specific Skills or benefits like a 15 percent critical hit chance. Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish is coming to Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC in Q3 2027. Head here to learn more about the various “pillars” of hunting.
